//: VS Code tasks for working on the ASCENT framework.
Phase 0 has no Makefile yet — these tasks are skeletons that exercise
the structure-check workflow locally so you don't push broken structure.

tasks.label: Validate repo structure (Phase 0)
args: echo 'Checking required files...' && for f in README.md CLAUDE.md CHANGELOG.md CONTRIBUTING.md LICENSE LICENSE-MIT LICENSE-APACHE .gitignore .editorconfig; do [ -f "$f" ] && echo "  ✓ $f" || echo "  ✗ MISSING: $f"; done && echo 'Checking framework docs...' && for f in docs/framework/PRINCIPLES.md docs/framework/PHILOSOPHY.md docs/framework/SCOPE.md docs/framework/ROADMAP.md docs/framework/ARCHITECTURE.md docs/framework/DECISIONS/INDEX.md; do [ -f "$f" ] && echo "  ✓ $f" || echo "  ✗ MISSING: $f"; done

tasks.label: Check for broken internal Markdown links
args: broken=0; while IFS=: read -r file link; do target="${link%%#*}"; [ -z "$target" ] && continue; dir="$(dirname "$file")"; resolved="$dir/$target"; if [ ! -e "$resolved" ]; then echo "  ✗ $file → $link"; broken=$((broken+1)); fi; done < <(grep -rEon '\]\(([^)]+)\)' --include='*.md' . 2>/dev/null | sed -E 's|^([^:]+):[0-9]+:\]\(([^)]+)\).*|\1:\2|' | grep -v 'http://\|https://\|mailto:' || true); echo ""; if [ "$broken" -gt 0 ]; then echo "✗ $broken broken links"; exit 1; else echo "✓ All internal links resolve"; fi
